voices.sourceText: Why not?! Come on, lend me some=@
voices.displayText: Why not?! Come on, lend me some...

voices.sourceText: See if I ask you anymore!
voices.displayText: See if I ask you anymore!

voices.sourceText: I know you'd only waste it.
voices.displayText: I know you'd only waste it.

voices.sourceText: Mai's hanging with a bad crowd＆and treating our family bad.
voices.displayText:
Mai's hanging with a bad crowd
and treating our family bad.

voices.sourceText: Ryo, could you talk to her?
voices.displayText: Ryo, could you talk to her?

voices.sourceText: She won't listen to me at all=@
voices.displayText: She won't listen to me at all...

voices.sourceText: Yes. Considering you've known＆her since she was young=@
voices.displayText:
Yes. Considering you've known
her since she was young...

voices.sourceText: She's somewhere in the harbor,＆behind the warehouses=@
voices.displayText:
She's somewhere in the harbor,
behind the warehouses...
